title: Coding order and scope of the before-push audit
summary: ShipGuard directs agents to implement the intended behavior before adding tests and to audit rules regardless of who first raised the problem.
route: Packaged UserPromptSubmit hook in an external project

changes.title: Verify the actual result and trace the source of rules
changes.problem: The hook mentioned an independent AI only and gave no instruction on test-driven coding.
changes.decision: Implement the requested behavior before adding regression tests. Before pushing, inspect rules prompted by the user, another AI, or the coding agent itself, including rules added without a new test.
changes.impact: The same project fixture receives the existing screenshot and before-push instructions plus the coding order and the broader audit scope.
tests: Updated hook smoke test passes at c4ede73d276e416a47c44fe7acf3afcfaecd138b and rejects baseline a2071130d308056eadad10c12ce37aac6c044d70.
Both revisions ran the packaged hook in the same empty project fixture. The captured results include the original screenshot instruction and the actual before-push context.
